info.title: Copilot Studio Credit Consumption
info.description: Power Platform API licensing endpoints for Copilot Credits: tenant capacity and per-agent consumption (billed and non-billed credits by environment, channel, feature, tool, model and knowledge source), per-user consumption and per-agent credit limits.

tags.name: Capacity
tags.description: Tenant and environment Copilot Credits capacity.

tags.name: Agent consumption
tags.description: Copilot Credits consumed by Copilot Studio agents.

get.description: Returns the tenant Copilot Credits capacity for the current month: entitled, allocated, consumed and available credits, pay-as-you-go consumption, overage status and the date the consumption data was last updated.

Returns Copilot Credits consumed by every Copilot Studio agent across all environments in a date range: billed and non-billed credits with agent, environment, channel, feature, tool, LLM model and knowledge source. Can group rows (for example by agent), keep the top N and estimate cost from a price per credit. Defaults to the current month up to yesterday (UTC).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size sent to the service. Defaults to 5000.

get.summary: List agent credit consumption in an environment
get.description: Returns Copilot Credits consumed by the Copilot Studio agents of one environment in a date range, with the same breakdown, grouping and cost options as 'List agent credit consumption'.

parameters.name: orderbyConsumed
parameters.description: Sort order passed to the service.

get.summary: List users of an agent by credit consumption
get.description: Returns the Copilot Credits consumed by each user of one Copilot Studio agent in a date range.

get.summary: List agents used by a user by credit consumption
get.description: Returns the Copilot Credits one user consumed with each Copilot Studio agent in a date range.
Returns the Copilot Credits consumed by each user of the tenant in a date range. Group by user to get one total per user.

parameters.name: orderbyConsumed
parameters.description: Sort order passed to the service.

get.description: Returns the Copilot Credits license trend for the tenant (licenses, quantities and entitled credits per date and license model).

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

get.description: Lists the monthly Copilot Credits limits set on individual Copilot Studio agents, with current consumption, percentage used, notification threshold and whether the agent stops when over the limit.

put.description: Creates or updates the monthly Copilot Credits limit of one Copilot Studio agent, its notification threshold and whether it stops when the limit is reached. Setting 'Stop agent' to true disables the agent.

get.description: Returns the capacity and pay-as-you-go entitlements of one environment (allocated, consumed and available quantities, overage status and enforcement rules), including Copilot Credits.
Lists the Power Platform environments available to the signed-in user, with ID, display name, type and region.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter on dataverseId, type, geo, state, environmentGroupId or domainName.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Maximum number of environments to return.

EntitlementId.name: entitlementId
EntitlementId.description: MCSMessages is the Copilot Credits entitlement used by Copilot Studio.

EnvironmentId.name: environmentId
EnvironmentId.description: ID of the Power Platform environment.

ResourceId.name: resourceId
ResourceId.description: ID of the Copilot Studio agent (agentId in the consumption results).

ResourceIdInEnvironment.name: resourceId
ResourceIdInEnvironment.description: ID of the Copilot Studio agent in the selected environment.

UserId.name: userId
UserId.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the user.

FromDate.name: fromDate
FromDate.description: First day of the range (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive). Defaults to the first day of the month of 'To date'.

ToDate.name: toDate
ToDate.description: Last day of the range (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive). Defaults to yesterday (UTC), the latest complete day.

GroupBy.name: groupBy
GroupBy.description: Sums credits per group. none returns the detailed rows. agent gives one total per agent.

Top.name: top
Top.description: Returns only the N rows or groups with the most billed credits.

PricePerCredit.name: pricePerCredit
PricePerCredit.description: Price of one Copilot Credit in your currency (your contract price). When set, estimatedCost = billed credits x price.

SplitByDay.name: splitByDay
SplitByDay.x-ms-summary: Query one day at a time
SplitByDay.description: Queries each day separately (max 92 days) so every row is attributed to its day in reportDate. Slower on long ranges.

IncludeEnvironmentNames.name: includeEnvironmentNames
IncludeEnvironmentNames.description: Adds environment display names to the rows (one extra call). Defaults to true.

FetchAllPages.name: fetchAllPages
FetchAllPages.description: Follows continuation tokens and returns every page in one response. Defaults to true.

PageSizeOptional.name: pageSize
PageSizeOptional.description: Page size sent to the service.

IncludeFields.name: includeFields
IncludeFields.description: Extra fields requested from the service. Defaults to users,tags,asOfDate.

SearchRequest.name: searchRequest
SearchRequest.description: Search text passed to the service to filter the results.

ContinuationToken.name: continuationToken
ContinuationToken.description: Token returned by a previous call when not all pages were read.

ConsumptionRow.description: One consumption row (or one group when Group by is set).

date.title: Date
date.description: Day of the row (yyyy-MM-dd): reportDate when querying day by day, otherwise the date part of asOfDate.

reportDate.title: Report date
reportDate.description: Queried day, when 'Query one day at a time' is on.

asOfDate.title: As of date
asOfDate.description: As-of date reported by the service.

agentId.title: Agent ID
agentId.description: ID of the Copilot Studio agent (resourceId).

environmentId.title: Environment ID
environmentId.description: ID of the environment of the agent.

environmentScenarioName.title: Environment scenario
environmentScenarioName.description: Scenario name of the environment, when set.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the user (user consumption rows).

estimatedCost.title: Estimated cost
estimatedCost.description: Billed credits x price per credit, when a price is supplied.

users.title: Users
users.description: Number of users reported for the row (detailed rows only).

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel where users interacted with the agent.

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: Feature that generated the charge, for example generative answers or agent flows.

product.title: Product
product.description: Product name reported by the service.

rowCount.title: Row count
rowCount.description: Number of detailed rows summed into this group.

metadata.title: Raw metadata
metadata.description: Metadata as returned by the service (detailed rows only).

totalBilledCredits.title: Total billed credits
totalBilledCredits.description: Billed credits of all rows, before Top N.

totalNonBilledCredits.title: Total non-billed credits
totalNonBilledCredits.description: Non-billed credits of all rows, before Top N.

totalEstimatedCost.title: Total estimated cost
totalEstimatedCost.description: Total billed credits x price per credit, when a price is supplied.

sourceRowCount.title: Source row count
sourceRowCount.description: Detailed rows returned by the service.

isComplete.title: Is complete
isComplete.description: False when not every page could be read; call again with the continuation token.

continuationToken.title: Continuation token
continuationToken.description: Token for the next page when isComplete is false.

resumeFromDate.title: Resume from date
resumeFromDate.description: With 'Query one day at a time', first day not read when isComplete is false: call again from this date.

value.title: Rows
value.description: Consumption rows, highest billed credits first.

entitledCredits.title: Entitled credits
entitledCredits.description: Prepaid Copilot Credits capacity for the month.

dataUpdatedOn.title: Data updated on
dataUpdatedOn.description: Latest completed usage date of the consumption data.

entitlement.title: Entitlement details
entitlement.description: Entitlement as returned by the service.

limit.title: Monthly limit
limit.description: Monthly Copilot Credits limit of the agent.

resourceConsumption.title: Current consumption
resourceConsumption.description: Credits consumed by the agent this month.

percentUsed.title: Percent used
percentUsed.description: Current consumption as a percentage of the limit (added by the connector).

isOverLimit.title: Is over limit
isOverLimit.description: True when consumption has reached the limit (added by the connector).

notificationThreshold.title: Notification threshold (%)
notificationThreshold.description: Percentage of the limit that triggers a notification.

notifyIfOverCapacity.title: Notify
notifyIfOverCapacity.description: Whether a notification is sent at the threshold.

stopIfOverCapacity.title: Stop when over limit
stopIfOverCapacity.description: Whether the agent stops consuming when it exceeds the limit.

stopResource.title: Agent stopped
stopResource.description: True when the agent was stopped explicitly (disabled).

createdOn.title: Created on
createdOn.description: When the limit was first configured.

limit.description: Monthly Copilot Credits limit of the agent.

notificationThreshold.description: Percentage of the limit that triggers a notification, for example 80.

notifyIfOverCapacity.description: Send a notification when consumption reaches the threshold.

stopIfOverCapacity.description: Stop the agent from consuming credits when it exceeds the limit.

stopResource.description: True disables the agent immediately; false re-enables it.

entitlement.title: Entitlement details
entitlement.description: Entitlement as returned by the service.
